purpose: Explain observed roaming from the selected vehicle's bounded drive-history arrivals, without presenting the inferred base as a verified home or the returned history as lifetime coverage.
primaryGoal: Inspect destinations, new versus repeat arrivals, monthly discovery, base-relative distances, rankings and the evidence limits behind those findings.

dataSources.name: useDriveHistory
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with a vehicle ID; history key ['drives', vehicleId, 'history', limit] is isolated from list/calendar queries; bounded 1-1000 limit, MODERATE staleTime, safeArray selection, AbortSignal forwarded. No date bounds or offset are passed.
dataSources.backendLimits: Hook documentation describes a 1000-row API cap. Handler/repository behavior, ordering, actual completeness and server filtering were not exercised or inspected; do not infer lifetime coverage.

dataSources.name: useSelectedVehicle / useVehicles
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id/path takes precedence over persisted selection, then first known fleet vehicle. The page consumes the workspace owner and renders no competing local selector.

dataSources.name: summarizeExplorer
dataSources.behavior: Pure client-side model: valid end coordinates, preferred valid end timestamp with start timestamp fallback; exclusive timestamp-first exclusion accounting; coarse 0.01-degree cells, centroid Haversine meters, visit-weighted P90, stable base tie-breaking, UTC monthly discovery, top-five farthest/rare lists and evidence thresholds. Coordinates do not leave the model. Arrival/coverage/cadence semantics must not change.

dataSources.name: Display and trust adapters
dataSources.behavior: useUnits.formatDistance converts source meters at render time; useDataState marks provenance historical and separates fatal failure from retained refresh failure. useNumberFormatting formats coverage/percent values; formatDate is used for destination dates; OperationalBrief metrics use useOperationalMetrics. Their transitive settings queries and actual persisted preference behavior were not exhaustively traced.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer / Grid
components.role: Full allocated-width orchestration; freshness metadata, route focus heading, subtitle help and inherited error boundary stay with the existing layout owner.

components.name: Explorer domain sections
components.role: Eight exported, named sections; CoverageMetrics, ExclusionAccounting and DiscoveryCadenceSummary are nested evidence subcomponents. ExplorerSectionBody owns local skeleton/fatal error/retry presentation.

components.name: DrivingSummaryBrief / NestedDrivingBrief / OperationalBrief
components.role: Existing summary and specialist formatter pipeline; each rendered brief exposes Review details through the canonical Drawer. Do not replace it with a new KPI card engine.

components.name: DataTable
components.role: Sorting, value filters, column preferences, pagination and loaded-row exports are shared-owned; mobile table currently prioritizes label/visits. No page-owned selection, row navigation or full-history export is configured.

components.name: ChartContainer and category chart primitives
components.role: Preserve persisted series toggles, chart image/CSV actions and screen-reader/forced-colors data alternatives. Neither page chart explicitly enables fullscreen or zoom.

components.name: Feedback, surfaces, typography and help
components.role: Reuse current feedback and semantic tokens rather than inventing loading/status/surface systems.

components.name: FadeIn
components.role: Six entry groups use the existing reduced-motion/low-bandwidth preference adapter; actual motion acceptance is unverified.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Farthest and rare lists repeat bordered ordinal/name/detail row markup at lines 78-119 and 143-182.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: A local typed ranking-row renderer can deduplicate the two lists, retaining distinct distance/arrival/date details. Do not propose a global composite without another independently inspected consumer.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Fatal error/retry is rendered independently in section bodies and both chart function children. The current repetition also repeats a single source failure across all sections.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Prefer existing ChartContainer error/onRetry props for chart-local failure; preserve all section shells and individual retry reachability. Reuse ExplorerSectionBody for non-chart sections; do not create another global async wrapper.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Page grids stack below xl; primary split is 3/2 at xl and bands/rankings split 1/1. Evidence and rankings nest lg two-column grids; coverage bars use md two columns. Directory shows label/visits on mobile. PageLayout keeps min-w-0, w-full and container composition.

issues.detail: Three threshold tiles are fixed grid-cols-3 below lg despite long localized labels, panel padding and enlarged text; narrow-container clipping is a source-supported risk, not an observed failure.
issues.fix: Use one column at the smallest allocated widths and three only when space supports full labels; preserve all thresholds and ranking explanation.

issues.detail: mobileColumns keeps only place/visits; repeat arrivals, base distance and first visit have no caller-configured mobile details renderer. The shared column menu may offer recovery, but mounted accessibility/reachability was not exercised.
issues.fix: Adopt the existing DataTable mobilePresentation contract or prove shared column-menu recovery for every hidden field; preserve sort/filter/export and stable table ID.

issues.detail: All four unit-dependent band labels are forced visible (interval=0) with no caller mobileHeight/size adaptation. Long translated range labels may collide in narrow containers; no viewport was tested.
issues.fix: Exercise narrow chart and fallback table; use existing ChartContainer responsive size props and preserve all four bands/series rather than dropping labels or data.

accessibility.sourceStrengths: Named section landmarks, decorative aria-hidden icons, localized help, loading role=status, chart ariaLabel/dataColumns alternatives, shared keyboard-capable controls and native ordered lists are present. FadeIn delegates reduced motion.

issues.detail: No localized caption/name is passed; DataTable falls back to the persistence identifier driving:explorer-destinations (DataTable.tsx:930), not the human section title.
issues.fix: Pass a localized destination-directory caption through the existing DataTable prop without changing tableId.

issues.detail: Both ranking destination names are truncate with no title or full-name disclosure at lines 95-96 and 160-163. Directory provides title but that alone is not touch/keyboard proof.
issues.fix: Allow wrapping or an existing accessible full-label disclosure; keep complete source names available on touch, keyboard and large-text layouts.

issues.detail: query populates freshness, but loading/busy are not supplied. PageContainer's aria-busy and load announcements derive from explicit loading/busy/error rather than query (PageContainer.tsx:137-142,174). Section skeletons provide local loading announcements; page completion announcement is not wired.
issues.fix: Pass source-state busy and ensure the canonical announcer covers completion without replacing all content with a page loading scaffold.

states.initialLoading: ExplorerSectionBody renders labeled skeletons; ChartContainer receives loading; summary brief receives loading and null numeric operands. Section shells remain mounted.
states.empty: No returned drives: summary offers /drives. Destination directory has no-coordinate/no-non-base distinction and /drives action; behavior/monthly/bands/rankings/coverage have independent EmptyState or evidence-needed text. Methodology remains explanatory after a successful empty response.
states.error: Only sourceState.fatalError is forwarded, preventing retained-history removal on background failure. Section retry invokes historyQuery.refetch. Chart errors are custom QueryError children.
states.staleOffline: StaleRefreshWarning beside retained content distinguishes blocked/offline refresh and supplies retry. ExplorerKpis receives retained; historical provenance and page freshness are preserved.
states.partialUnavailable: Single drive-history source; eligibility/exclusions and base/behavior/ranking/cadence thresholds disclose limited evidence. No synthetic partial endpoint is invented.
states.noVehicle: NoVehicleSelected replaces the page when vehicleId is null and links to governed onboarding action. The selection hook does not expose fleet query loading/error, so a transient unresolved fleet can look like no selection; this shared boundary is not runtime-tested.

issues.detail: ExplorerSectionState carries loading/error/retry only. NestedDrivingBrief supports retained but behavior/coverage/cadence callers omit it, so retained history can show Returned evidence in nested briefs while the top summary shows Retained evidence.
issues.fix: Forward retained trust through the existing section state and nested brief props; keep successful data visible and preserve global warning/freshness.

issues.detail: Evidence badges outside state body also render during initial loading or fatal failure, using the empty-derived summary (rankings, behavior, coverage and methodology). They can claim Two destinations required or below row cap before evidence has returned.
issues.fix: Use existing neutral pending/unavailable badge states while loading/fatal; distinguish unknown from insufficient measured evidence. Retain the evidence thresholds once data resolves.

visualIssues.detail: Coverage and new/repeat MetricBars omit fill, inheriting gradient. MetricBar.tsx:44 and 96 already support solid rendering. These are decorative gradients rather than a necessary domain encoding.
visualIssues.fix: Use fill='solid' with restrained current semantic/theme colors; preserve percentages, labels and unknown handling.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed cyan/purple/amber/emerald text decorates section icons, method icons and rank ordinals across the feature. These are toned colors, not neon violations, but many do not encode a domain severity and lack theme-specific mapping.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral token roles for decorative structure; reserve semantic color for actual evidence warnings/status and intentional chart series. Measure composed light/dark contrast before claiming compliance.

visualIssues.detail: OperationalBrief panels inside GlassPanel, plus repeated bordered explanation/threshold boxes, layer chrome and repeated source/status descriptions in already dense evidence sections. No content removal is authorized.
visualIssues.fix: Review hierarchy using existing compact brief and shared surfaces; simplify local borders/spacing and keep descriptions/provenance/detail actions fully available. Do not create a replacement summary component.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports StatMetric through the implementation-specific data-display/stat-reference barrel; same pattern occurs in coverage/behavior/cadence and driving brief adapters. Existing production guidance favors category ownership; type re-export availability at category root was not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the shared data-display export owner confirm the supported public type path before changing consumers; do not add local parallel metric types.

priority.first: Preserve trust in retained/pending states and full mobile directory/long-label access, then reduce decorative gradients/color/chrome.
priority.reason: The page already has strong decomposition, SI display boundaries, isolated history query and substantial source explanations; modernization is not a restoration or permission to delete complex sections.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Selection prerequisite trust exposure
props: Existing vehicleId/vehicle/vehicles/setVehicleId remain unchanged; if confirmed necessary, expose additive fleet loading/fatal/retained trust from the existing useVehicles query
dependsOn: Shared-owner inspection of other callers before an API change
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Selection output does not expose fleet-query trust. Avoid making an unresolved vehicle list indistinguishable from setup absence.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Shared owner should verify boundary behavior and extend the existing contract only if needed; no page-owned duplicate vehicles query or new selector.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical metric type export confirmation
dependsOn: Category export owner's confirmation; root export was not inspected
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Confirm supported type import ownership rather than creating competing metric types.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Reuse a confirmed existing category export or have its sole owner provide a compatible type-only export.

competingImplementations.name: No competing page data/store/selector system found in inspected Explorer sources
competingImplementations.decision: Keep useDriveHistory, workspace vehicle owner, pure model, shared trust/layout/summary/table/chart owners. Do not add a new explorer API, map/geofence engine or UI library.

competingImplementations.name: Bounded history is not workspace date scope
competingImplementations.decision: /explorer is not range-enabled and does not consume useRangeState. Preserve current observed-history scope and cap disclosure; adding a date scope is a separately coordinated integration change, not an audit-assumed defect.

preservation.lineCountBasis: Page plus all 14 files in components\explorer, including barrel/types; operational brief adapters and pure model excluded from this count and independently cited.

dataBehavior: Preserve encoded vehicle_id, enabled guard, history query key/limit/staleTime/safeArray and AbortSignal; do not silently switch to default list-page history.
Preserve model thresholds: 3 base arrivals, 2 repeated base visits, 3 behavior arrivals, 2 destinations for ranking and 3 discoveries for cadence.
Do not treat unknown distance/cadence/coverage as measured zero; guarded percent fallbacks currently execute only inside nonempty sections.
Keep SI meters and raw operands in cache/model; formatDistance only at display. Cadence days are internal derived intervals adapted to duration seconds in the presentation formatter.
Keep base exclusion only after sufficient evidence, stable chronological/tie ordering, centroid distances, visit-weighted P90, UTC monthly aggregation and top-five rare/farthest rules.
Preserve privacy boundary: no raw coordinate values exported from the model, no fabricated geofence/home identification.
Keep all eight sections during successful empty/insufficient states, independent retry surfaces and retained data after refresh failure.
Preserve tableId driving:explorer-destinations, chartKey/export filenames explorer-monthly-discovery and explorer-distance-bands; do not reset saved preferences or legend state.
preservation.sourcePatternScope: ExplorerPage.tsx and components\explorer\*.tsx only; line-oriented pattern counts are not a complete AST/whole-app audit.
